correctness.rationale: Petersen root vertex has 3 incident edges and contributes a triangle energy -J or +3J. Therefore H=-10J+4JB-h(15-2k), and the degree sum identity B=10-2k+n2+3n3 proves the energy envelope for all real h and gives matching/NAE equality cases. Independently enumerated all 32768 labelled spin assignments, 30 bonds and 105 pairs, obtaining zero-field coefficient vector 6,195,690,690,195,6; shell pair numerators -594,190,-290 and shell sizes 30,60,15; checked matching polynomial (1,15,75,145,90,6), total 332, and field samples h/J=0,1,4,5. Read both supplied independent inclusion-exclusion and Kneser-construction complete verifier source files; no extrapolation to other graphs.

value.rationale: Petersen is canonical smallest snark; its line graph gives a symmetric nonbipartite fifteen-spin cluster of ten frustrated triangles. Complete zero-temperature finite-system magnetization and distance-shell two-point correlations, especially negative third-shell correlation, distinguish frustration structure beyond the known matching polynomial. This natural exact finite classification needs no bulk-phase or downstream theorem to be useful.

final_claim: For Ising antiferromagnet J>0 on 15 sites of Petersen L(P), exact E0(h)=-10J-5|h| for |h|<=4J and 30J-15|h| otherwise; ground degeneracies 1782 at h=0, six in interior one-third plateau, 332 at |h|=4J and one beyond. Zero-field magnetization polynomial 6(z^5+z^10)+195(z^6+z^9)+690(z^7+z^8); shell correlations C1=-1/3,C2=95/891,C3=-145/891.
